elements.title: Dirini (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the relationship between the Dirini (example pictured) and its closest relative has been described by researchers as "odd"?

elements.title: Zhang Zhiyun (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Zhang Zhiyun, crowned "movie queen" in a newspaper poll in 1926, is reported to have died homeless in Hong Kong?

elements.title: Council of Tripoli (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that summons to the Council of Tripoli were issued in the name of the Church to bypass the issue of whether a king could summon a prince?

elements.title: Swim School (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a Swim School song described by one reviewer as "a heavy dystopian doom rocker" was originally performed by Taylor Swift?

elements.title: Mink (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Japanese manga series Mink featured futuristic technology even though its creator was unfamiliar with computers?

elements.title: a song (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Airbnb homestay where a song was recorded by Glaive and Ericdoa was dubbed by fans as the "Hyperpop Hype House"?

elements.title: the fourth president of Austria (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the fourth president of Austria's post-secondary instructors included all three of his predecessors?

elements.title: Catch II (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Catch II game had "one of the most amazing finishes in NFL postseason history", according to the NFL?

elements.title: a cheese-filled waffle (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Bank of Korea asked the makers of a cheese-filled waffle to change its design?
